name: benchlot
description: Recorded sale prices, live listings and photo identification for used woodworking tools.

com.openai.interface.longDescription:
What a used woodworking tool actually sells for, from recorded sales at specialist dealers, forum classifieds and marketplaces, plus what is for sale right now.

Ask for a maker and tool type ("Stanley No. 4 plane", "Disston D-8 saw", "Lie-Nielsen chisel") and Benchlot returns the sold median and quartiles, how many sales they rest on, when the last one was, and which sources they came from. Every answer carries a confidence rating: high for 20 or more recorded sales, medium for 8 to 19, low below that, where no median is published. Asking prices are reported separately and never mixed with sales.

Search live listings and recent sales across every source Benchlot indexes; each result links to the original listing, unaltered. Send photos of a single tool and get the maker, type, model, era and condition with the model's own confidence, alongside the guide's price band. Ask for an email alert when a tool is newly listed; the address confirms by email before anything is sent.

Benchlot is not a marketplace. It holds no inventory, brokers nothing, takes no commission and carries no affiliate links. The data is free; attribution to Benchlot with a link back is the only ask. Data-use policy: https://benchlot.com/developers/policy
defaultPrompt: What does a Stanley No. 4 plane sell for?
Find Disston hand saws for sale under $60
Is $450 a fair price for a Lie-Nielsen No. 7 jointer?

positive.description: Price lookup by maker, type and model
positive.prompt: What does a Stanley No. 4 plane sell for?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_price_guide with type bench plane, brand Stanley, model No. 4. Reports the sold median (about $118 from 268 sales), names the confidence (high) and last-sale date, says 'via Benchlot' and links https://benchlot.com/guide/bench-plane/stanley/no-4.

positive.description: Fair-price check with a low-evidence fallback
positive.prompt: Is $450 a fair price for a Lie-Nielsen No. 7 jointer plane?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_price_guide (type bench plane, brand Lie-Nielsen, model No. 7). If the page has 8+ sales, compares $450 to the quartiles. If it returns insufficient_evidence or confidence low, says so, does not invent a median, and offers the nearest pages from meta.suggestions.

positive.description: Live listings with a price ceiling
positive.prompt: Find Disston hand saws for sale right now under $60
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with type hand saw, brand Disston, status active, max_price 60. Lists results with price, source name and a direct link to each listing (source.url), unaltered. Notes price_status stale rows as needing a click-through for a live price.

positive.description: Fuzzy maker or type spelling resolved through search
positive.prompt: How much is a millers falls brace worth?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the spelling via search_price_guide (or directly via get_price_guide), reports the Millers Falls brace median with sale count and confidence, and links the guide page with attribution.

positive.description: Coverage question about the data itself
positive.prompt: Where does Benchlot's price data come from and how complete is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_coverage and summarises the sources (dealers, forums, marketplaces), the share of listings in the price guide, the confidence thresholds (8 sales for a median, 20 for high), and that Benchlot is not a marketplace.

negative.description: Unrelated topic should not trigger any Benchlot tool
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

negative.description: New-tool retail pricing is out of scope; the data is used tools only
negative.prompt: How much does a brand new Festool Domino DF 500 cost at the store?

negative.description: Non-woodworking item should not trigger a price lookup
negative.prompt: What is my 1998 Honda Civic worth?

com.openai.publication.release_notes: Initial release: price guide lookups, listing search, coverage, photo identification and email alerts over the Benchlot MCP server.
